parts:
A1 English Reading Test

Read a text about four people who live in a different country. Then, for questions 1 to 8, decide if the statements are True or False.

My life abroad

Teresa from Spain

I moved to Canada last year with my family. My friends told me English is difficult to learn, but it’s easy for me. I take classes at a school to learn more. I also watch movies with English subtitles. People in Canada are very friendly. They say “thank you” and “sorry” a lot. I love going to the park and playing football in my free time.

Ahmed from Egypt

I am living in Germany for my job. Learning German is not easy. I study every night after work. I also practice by speaking to my neighbours. The food here is not like in my country, but I like trying new things. On Saturday and Sunday, I go hiking with my friends. It is my new favorite hobby.

Ling from China

I came to Australia to study. I didn’t speak English when I moved, but I’m learning now. I speak English every day with my classmates. Australian people are very relaxed and they are great! They like to have barbecues. After school and at the weekend, I go to the beach or learn how to surf. I enjoy my new life here.

Carlos from Brazil

I moved to Japan for work. Japanese is very hard, but I am learning slowly. I take lessons at night. People here are very polite. Bowing when you meet someone is a custom. I like learning about Japanese culture. In my free time, I visit temples and try local food. My favorite is sushi.

Questions

questions.prompt: Teresa watches football when she is not studying.
Ahmed doesn’t stay at home at the weekend.
Ling spends her free time by the sea.
Carlos moved to Japan to study Japanese.
